cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

mechanism: A uses its pupil better inspection skills as grounds for formal joint custody and shared replacement decisions, increasing help through shared accountability.
confusable: Not merely asking a trained helper to carry something: official signing and joint approval share the consequences.
comparison: Borrowed equipment risk versus public school-trip accountability.
